summary.text: Arthur Boyer is the Democratic candidate for the Florida House of Representatives, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Liesa Priddy; there is no incumbent in the race.
Boyer previously ran for the Collier County Public Schools school board in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Arthur Boyer was one of five candidates in the August 23, 2022 nonpartisan primary for Collier County Public Schools school board District 5, finishing with 10.2 percent of the vote (6,887 votes); Timothy Moshier and incumbent Roy Terry III advanced.
